title: Affine lifting of etale inverse-image sections
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to Scheme$ an inverse system of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps, and $c$ a limit cone [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Fix $i_0$, a sheaf of sets $G$ on $D(i_0)$, and an etale object $W$ whose source is affine and whose structure map is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Every section $t$ of the inverse image of $G$ on $W\times_{D(i_0)}c.pt$ is the image, under the canonical cone section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison], of a section at some object $j$ of $Over(i_0^{op})$.

source.document: Stacks Project, Étale Cohomology and Sites (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu)
source.place: Tags 09YQ, 0EYL, 04HR and 09YN; finite affine-cover descent from 03Q4 and 0738

proof.text: Pass to the cofinal upper tail. Transition maps are affine by hypothesis and limit projections are affine by the limit-affine theorem (transport from its chosen limit to c). Use the affine-etale site colimit and restriction equivalences. The unit-compatible affine inverse-image comparison transports the sheaves and their transition isomorphisms to this site presentation. Composition identifies the inverse-image sheaves at the limit with a constant system, whose colimit is that inverse image by connectedness. The colimit-of-sites sections theorem therefore identifies the filtered colimit of affine stage sections with the limit sections, with the displayed unit/composition maps. Restrict to affine W₀. The surjectivity of the identified colimit map and the existence of stage representatives give j and s. The compatibility with units and pullback pasting gives the exact displayed comparison equation.

proof_origin.place: Set-valued degree-zero adaptation of the stated site-colimit and finite-affine-cover proof; concrete intermediate formulation by C2
